findings.desc: CHK-003 userSees says "self-smoke proves flagged-FAIL retried + non-flagged-FAIL not retried" but there is no self-smoke case for the explicitly stated invariant "a flagged smoke that FAILs BOTH passes still counts as a final FAIL (no masking)". The code logic is correct (merge replaces pass1 FAIL with pass2 FAIL, anyFail check triggers exit 1) but this third sub-case from the story spec is not asserted in any test. File: packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts — add a case 14: fixture-always-fail-E with retryOnAnyFailure:true that exits 1 on every run, assert code===1 and stdout.includes("Final:") and /Final:\s*0\/1/.test(stdout).
findings.resolvedReason: Added self-smoke case (14) 'B-348d (c)': fixture-hardfail-flagged-E exits 1 every run AND is flagged retryOnAnyFailure:true. Asserts it IS retried in pass 2 (retrying serially) yet the retry also fails so the suite stays terminal: exit 1 and Final 0/1. Self-smoke now 16/16 (commit dd3af4f71). Covers the invariant 'a flagged smoke that FAILs BOTH passes still counts as a final FAIL'.
